          Como 4-1 Man Utd Stats: Red Devils Thumped in Italy as Pressure on Carrick Grows
        
      
                          
                      Oct 21, 2026
          
                      Chloe Horswill / Author
                  
      
              
                      
                  
          

    
              
      
              
                    
Cesc Fabregas' Como tore Manchester United apart in their Champions League meeting on Wednesday. Look back on the action with our Como vs Man Utd stats page.
Nico Paz was instrumental as Como blew Manchester United away with a 4-1 win at Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia in the Champions League.
The 22-year-old got the ball rolling with the opener in just the second minute, and ended the game with a brace and an assist after a stellar performance.

Tasos Douvikas and Jacobo Ramón were also both on target in the thumping victory, which piled further pressure on Michael Carrick, whose side are now winless in their last seven games in all competitions, though they did pull a goal back late on through substitute Joshua Zirkzee.
Diogo Dalot passed up a presentable chance with 84 seconds on the clock; having initially mis-controlled the ball, he recovered but bent his shot wide of the far post.
And 34 seconds later, Como made them pay for that miss. The hosts went straight up the other end, and Paz curled a stunning strike into the left corner of the net.

United failed to muster a response, and Como finished the half on top. Douvikas had the beating of Matthijs de Ligt – making his first appearance in 325 days – and fired a tight-angled effort at Senne Lammens, who brought the forward down on his next attack, but the offside flag meant no penalty was awarded.

Como picked up where they left off after the break as they easily cut through United's defence in the 49th minute, with Paz laying it off to Douvikas, who profited from a De Ligt stumble to brilliantly finish past Lammens.
And things went from bad to worse for United 57 minutes in. Paz pounced on Carlos Baleba‘s blind pass, and raced down the right to finish into the bottom-left corner.
United's urgency grew after that, with substitute Amad Diallo finding space on the edge of the box to test Jean Butez with a dipping strike that was tipped over the crossbar.
Como soon wrestled back momentum, though, and Ramon finished off a wonderful team move after Kaiki chipped a lovely cross into the box 76 minutes in.

Zirkzee netted a late consolation for United, plucking Diallo's cross out of the air before scuffing his strike through Butez's legs in the 91st minute, but it was the only bright spot in an otherwise chastening night for Carrick and his men.

Como's starting XI have made a combined 62 Champions League appearances (prior to this match), compared to the 242 in United's starting line-up, but based on their respective performances, that was not evident.

Cesc Fabregas' side came flying out of the blocks, and their early goal meant United had conceded two goals in the opening two minutes of Champions League games this season, already their most in this time period in a single edition.
In fact, they are the first English team to concede in the first two minutes of consecutive major European matches.

Paz caused all their problems, as he became just the fourth player to be directly involved in at least three goals in a Champions League game against United, and the youngest to do so (aged 22 years and 43 days).
The Argentinian also became the second-youngest South American player to find the net in competition against United, after Lionel Messi (21y 337d in the 2009 final).
Como have settled into the Champions League brilliantly, becoming the first Italian side to win their first two home games since Lazio in 1999-00.
For United, though, it leaves more questions as their torrid away form in UEFA's premier competition; they have won just one of their last 11 games on the road in the Champions League (D3 L7).
They mustered 1.05 expected goals (xG) from 12 shots to Como's 2.04, with Fabregas' side getting eight of their 11 attempts on target.
